decisive_items: Smooth muscle actin (SMA) was diffusely positive in the tumor cells
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels
concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells present around small vessels over a hyalinized background stroma
response.rationale: Tumor cells are SMA-positive perivascular ovoid cells with hyalinized stroma, mitoses, and necrosis, fitting glomus tumor; CD31 highlights only endothelial channels, not tumor cells, excluding angiosarcoma.

rejected.why: CD31 highlights endothelium, not tumor cells; benign hemangioma lacks atypical mitoses and necrosis.
History of SCC is incidental; histology and SMA positivity are not squamous.
Dermatofibroma lacks concentric perivascular proliferation and SMA-diffuse pattern with necrosis.
Too nonspecific; CD31 is endothelial, not tumor cell marker.
Angiosarcoma would show CD31-positive tumor cells, not SMA-positive perivascular cells.
Clinical appearance overlaps but histology and IHC exclude basal cell carcinoma.
DFSP is CD34-positive, SMA-negative, and lacks perivascular concentric pattern.
KSHV negative and histology not Kaposi sarcoma.
